SAME hammer: chunky symmetrical twin head in dark metal with steel plates, bronze angular collars, small central spike, leather grip and straight shaft, thin school-colored illuminated seams. Refined low-resolution rendered-volume/fine-shaded Heroes III-like sprite sensibility, clear silhouette; not chunky cartoon outlines or anime. Identical character size and body proportions, identical boots, outfit, hammer dimensions, centered root position and planted feet at SAME BASELINE 88% of each cell; full character and weapon uncropped inside each cell with ample margins, no neighboring overlap. All SIX frames must show genuinely DIFFERENT contiguous phases of the specified action, not six copies. Frame 1 and 6 return to the same ready pose for a loop. No opponent, incoming weapon, damage number, explosion or new magical shield. This is an artistic defence motion proposal, not a new gameplay rule. CANDIDATE 1: FIRE HIGH-SHAFT PARRY. Red-orange illuminated hammer seams. Frame 1 relaxed low hammer ready pose. Frame 2 knees compress and both hands lift shaft toward face. Frame 5 hammer lowers through recovery, no attack swing or retaliation. Frame 6 returns exactly to frame 1 ready pose. Clear swift defensive interception, no downward hit against an enemy.
